impact.text: The user's USDM is sitting in the vault (transferred there at `requestRedeem`) and can never be burned or returned -- there is no refund path.

precondition_sources.text: A user calls requestRedeem, transferring their USDM to the vault and incrementing totalOwed in RedeemEscrow via addObligation.
The redeeming user is blacklisted by Circle between requestRedeem and claimRedeem.

intent_sources.text: The user's USDM transferred at requestRedeem must be burnable or returnable via a refund path.
